string.text: Skill Mastery Redux
Global Settings
Player Settings
Companion Settings
AI Lord Settings
Show Mastery Messages
Show an on-screen message when a mastery perk is unlocked in the character screen and when a skill is fully mastered. [Default: enabled]
Disable Perk Safeguards

Removes the cap that keeps every mastery perk reachable at or below skill level 330. Skills keep learning at the minimum learning rate past 330, so higher tiers stay reachable, just later. [Default: disabled]
Show Skill Limit on Skill Bar
Marks the level from which a skill only learns at the minimum learning rate (vanilla stops there) on the character screen skill bar and adds it to the learning limit tooltip. [Default: enabled]
Learning Settings
Minimum Learning Rate
Every hero always learns a skill at least this fast, even past its learning limit. Skills are no longer capped at 330, so every mastery perk stays reachable. [Default: 0.30]
Mastery Perk Cost Offset

Extra skill levels required per perk tier for the player's mastery perks. With safeguards enabled it is reduced so the last tier stays at or below 330 (8/5/2 for 250/275/300 skills at the default starting offset). [Default: 20]
Mastery Starting Level Offset
Shifts the skill level at which the player's mastery perks begin. Keep the cost offset at 20 when lowering this so the tiers still scale up to 330. [Default: 0]
Auto-assign Mastery Perks
Available mastery perks for the player are acquired automatically when the character screen refreshes. [Default: disabled]
Allow Companions to Master Skills
Heroes of your clan can unlock mastery perks. If disabled, only the player can. [Default: enabled]
Mastery Perk Cost Offset
Extra skill levels required per perk tier for companion and AI lord mastery perks. Same safeguard as the player value. [Default: 20]
Mastery Starting Level Offset
Shifts the skill level at which companion and AI lord mastery perks begin. [Default: 0]
Auto-assign Mastery Perks
Companions acquire available mastery perks automatically, daily and when the character screen refreshes. If disabled, you unlock them in the character screen. [Default: enabled]
Allow AI Lords to Master Skills
Lords outside your clan acquire mastery perks automatically on their daily tick, using the companion offsets. [Default: enabled]

Show Unspent Points in Hero List

Marks heroes in the character screen hero list: an orange circle for unspent attribute or focus points and a shield with the number of perks to choose. Applies the next time the character screen opens. [Default: enabled]
Technical settings
Logging for debugging
Logging for debugging (English only). [Default: disabled]
Attribute Bonuses
Enable Attribute Bonuses

Every attribute point gives the bonuses listed under its attribute below. Combat and personal bonuses use the hero's own attribute, party bonuses the party leader's and clan bonuses the clan leader's. Only heroes have attributes, so troops get nothing. Works in the campaign only. Hover over an attribute in the character screen to see its bonuses. [Default: enabled]
Overwrite Better Attributes Mod
If the Better Attributes mod is loaded too, switches it off so the bonuses of both mods do not add up. If disabled, both mods give their bonuses. Applies after a game restart. [Default: enabled]
Turns every bonus of this attribute on or off. [Default: enabled]
Bonus per Attribute Point
Social Points per Companion
Who Gets It

Player: only you. Player's Clan: you and the heroes of your clan. All Heroes: every hero, AI lords included. For party and clan bonuses this is checked on the party or clan leader. [Default: All Heroes]
Player's Clan
All Heroes
Character Screen
Show Only Bonuses in Attribute Tooltip

The attribute tooltip in the character screen lists that attribute's bonuses for the selected hero. If enabled, the list replaces the game's text about adding points, so long lists fit. If disabled, the game's text follows the list. [Default: enabled]
{BONUS}: {VALUE}
Melee Damage
The hero's melee weapon attacks deal more damage, counted before armor. Kicks, shield bashes and unarmed attacks are not affected. At the default 1.5% per point: +15% at Vigor 10. [Default: enabled]
Melee damage per point of Vigor. [Default: 1.5%]
Draw Speed
The hero draws bows and readies thrusts and throws faster. At the default 1% per point: +10% at Vigor 10. [Default: enabled]
Draw speed per point of Vigor. [Default: 1.0%]
Crush Through Power

The hero's overhead swings count as stronger when the game decides if they crush through a block. As in the base game, only overhead swings can crush through. At the default 1% per point: +10% power at Vigor 10. Not compatible with Realistic Battle Mod, which has its own rules for this. [Default: disabled]
Crush through power per point of Vigor. [Default: 1.0%]
Slice Through Chance

Chance that the hero's melee swing loses no power when it cuts through an enemy, so the next enemy it reaches is hit at full strength. At the default 1% per point: 10% at Vigor 10. Not compatible with Realistic Battle Mod, which has its own rules for this. [Default: disabled]
Slice through chance per point of Vigor. [Default: 1.0%]
Ranged Damage
The hero's arrows, bolts and thrown weapons deal more damage, counted before armor. At the default 1.5% per point: +15% at Control 10. [Default: enabled]
Ranged damage per point of Control. [Default: 1.5%]
The hero's ranged attacks spread less. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Control 10, so the spread is divided by 1.2. [Default: enabled]
Accuracy per point of Control. [Default: 2.0%]
Reload Speed
The hero reloads faster. At the default 1.5% per point: +15% at Control 10. [Default: enabled]
Reload speed per point of Control. [Default: 1.5%]
Weapon Handling
The hero handles weapons more nimbly (the weapon handling stat). At the default 1% per point: +10% at Control 10. [Default: enabled]
Weapon handling per point of Control. [Default: 1.0%]
Max Hit Points
The hero has more hit points. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Endurance 10, which is +20 hit points on the base 100. [Default: enabled]
Hit points per point of Endurance. [Default: 2.0%]
Stagger Resistance
The hero can take bigger hits without the attack in progress being interrupted. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Endurance 10. [Default: enabled]
Stagger resistance per point of Endurance. [Default: 2.0%]
Aim Stability
The hero can hold a drawn bow steady longer before the aim starts to shake. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Endurance 10. [Default: enabled]
Aim stability per point of Endurance. [Default: 2.0%]
Movement Speed
The hero moves faster on foot. At the default 0.5% per point: +5% at Endurance 10. [Default: enabled]
Movement speed per point of Endurance. [Default: 0.5%]
Smithing Stamina
The hero has more maximum smithing stamina. At the default 5 per point: +50 at Endurance 10 (the base game gives 100 plus half the Smithing skill). [Default: enabled]
Smithing stamina per point of Endurance. [Default: 5]
Simulation Advantage

In simulated battles (sending troops, and battles fought without you), every troop of the party deals more damage. Uses the party leader's Cunning. At the default 1% per point: +10% at Cunning 10. [Default: enabled]
Simulated damage per point of the party leader's Cunning. [Default: 1.0%]
Renown from Victories
Won battles give more renown. Uses the party leader's Cunning. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Cunning 10. [Default: enabled]
Renown per point of the party leader's Cunning. [Default: 2.0%]
Morale from Victories
Won battles raise the party's morale more. Uses the party leader's Cunning. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Cunning 10. [Default: enabled]
Morale per point of the party leader's Cunning. [Default: 2.0%]
Persuasion Chance

Your persuasion attempts in conversations succeed more often and fail critically less often, the same way the game's own persuasion bonuses work. Player only. At the default 1.5% per point: +15% at Social 10. [Default: enabled]
Persuasion chance per point of your Social. [Default: 1.5%]
Party Morale
The party's morale is higher. Uses the party leader's Social. At the default 1% per point: +10% at Social 10. [Default: enabled]
Party morale per point of the party leader's Social. [Default: 1.0%]
Party Size
The party can hold more troops. Uses the party leader's Social. At the default 1% per point: +10% at Social 10. [Default: enabled]
Party size per point of the party leader's Social. [Default: 1.0%]
Party Wages
The party pays less in troop wages. Uses the party leader's Social. At the default 1% per point: -10% at Social 10. [Default: enabled]
Wage reduction per point of the party leader's Social. [Default: 1.0%]
Companion Limit
The clan can have more companions. Uses the clan leader's Social. At the default of 4 points per companion: +2 companions at Social 10. [Default: enabled]
Points of the clan leader's Social needed for each extra companion. [Default: 4]
Clan Income
The clan's daily income is higher. Uses the clan leader's Intelligence. At the default 1% per point: +10% at Intelligence 10. [Default: enabled]
Clan income per point of the clan leader's Intelligence. [Default: 1.0%]
Influence from Victories
Won battles give more influence (only clans in a kingdom gain influence). Uses the party leader's Intelligence. At the default 2% per point: +20% at Intelligence 10. [Default: enabled]
Influence per point of the party leader's Intelligence. [Default: 2.0%]
Experience Gain
The hero gains more experience. At the default 1% per point: +10% at Intelligence 10. [Default: enabled]
Experience per point of Intelligence. [Default: 1.0%]
Party Leader Experience from Roles

When the party's scout, engineer, surgeon or quartermaster gains experience in the skill of that role, the party leader gains a share of it too. Uses the party leader's Intelligence. At the default 2% per point: 20% of it at Intelligence 10. [Default: enabled]
Share of the role's experience per point of the party leader's Intelligence. [Default: 2.0%]
Hero Healing Rate
Heroes in the party heal faster. Uses the party leader's Intelligence. At the default 3% per point: +30% at Intelligence 10. [Default: disabled]
Hero healing rate per point of the party leader's Intelligence. [Default: 3.0%]
